summary: The main article describes a Cp*Co(III)-catalyzed synthesis of isoquinolines via site-selective C-H activation. It includes optimization tables comparing cobalt and rhodium catalysts, scope tables for various oximes and alkynes, and mechanistic schemes including deuterium labeling and proposed pathways.

items.description: Comparison of site selectivity between Rh and Co catalysts in the synthesis of isoquinolines from unsymmetrical oximes.
